headline: Genus Paper & Boards announces change in its board of directors
summary: Genus Paper & Boards Limited has formally notified the stock exchange about a change in its board of directors. The company submitted this routine corporate governance filing through official regulatory channels. Such board-level transitions are standard procedural updates for listed entities. Retail investors track these changes to monitor management stability and corporate governance standards.
why_it_matters: Routine management updates have negligible immediate impact on stock price.

headline: Genus Paper & Boards files financial results for the period ending September 30, 2026
summary: Genus Paper & Boards Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. The filing provides the company's financial performance data for the specified period. Retail investors and stakeholders can review the reported numbers to assess the company's operational progress during the quarter.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal the latest financial health of the company.
